recipes.name: Sausage Egg Casserole
ingredients_raw: 2 (4 ounce) cans diced green chile peppers, drained

steps.text: Place sausage in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium-high heat until evenly brown. Drain, and set aside. Melt butter in skillet, and cook and stir the green onions and mushrooms until tender.
In a large bowl, mix the eggs, cottage cheese, Monterey Jack cheese, and chiles. Stir in the sausage, green onions, and mushrooms. Cover, and refrigerate overnight.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a bowl, sift together the flour, baking powder, and salt. Blend in the melted butter. Stir the flour mixture into the egg mixture. Pour into the prepared baking dish.
Bake 40 to 50 minutes in the preheated oven, or until lightly brown. Let stand 10 minutes before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Sausage Egg Casserole
raw_recipe.description: Assemble the ingredients the night before, and bake this casserole in the morning. Stand back and wait for the compliments. I've made it with fat free cottage cheese, egg substitute, and reduced fat sausage; the taste is still wonderful!

video.description: A great make-ahead casserole with sausage, mushrooms, and cheese.

review.reviewBody: This recipe was great. I made it for Easter breakfast and it was a big hit! I did change the recipe a little...used 12 eggs, 1 lb. of sage sausage, and I chopped up 1 large green bell pepper and 1/2 a large onion and sauted them instead of using the green onions, mushrooms, and canned peppers. I also used 8 oz. of shredded sharp cheddar instead of the 16 oz. of jack cheese after reading the reviews that it was too cheesy. I used a pastry cutter to combine the flour mixture to make sure it wasn't lumpy, and it turned out wonderful! I'll definitely use this again. Thank you!!

A unanimous hit with our extended family. Made exactly as written except instead of flour, buzzed some rolled oats in the Vita-Mix blender to make oat flour. Did melt the butter for the roux in a microwave, then crumbled the flour/butter/baking powder mixture onto the egg mixture, then mixed with a pastry cutter first to be sure it was well incorporated and not in clumps. Made the night before as directed, then added the roux the next morning. Had salsa on hand in case it was bland but no need. Used 1# of Jimmy Dean original sausage. YUM!
The BEST crustless quiche I’ve ever had. Very flavorful!! I omitted the flour and baking soda used 1 full lb of sausage so I didn’t have 1/4 lb left over and it was spectacular!!
This was delicious!!!! Great flavor! Used 18 oz precooked sausage. Covered in oven for first 40 min then uncovered for 15-20. Perfect!!!!

For a Keto friendly / Gluten free version, skip the flour and baking powder and substitute a cup of Keto pancake/waffle mix. I reduced the salt to about 1/4 teaspoon. Increased cooking time to an hour (could take less if you use a larger pan but the 9x13 was quite dense and required more baking time). We topped ours with Salsa. Great option for a savory breakfast!

After reading the reviews that it was bland and too cheesy, I used a hot sausage and added about 1tsp of mustard powder to the eggs and reduced cheese to about 3/4 substituting part with cheddar. We thought it was great. It was more dense like a bread pudding which I thought made it hardy. Definately used a pastry cutter for the dough as someone suggested. Came out perfect. Would make again!

TBD: Trying :


 12 eggs, 1 lb. of sage, pork or turkey sausage, chopped up 1 large green bell pepper and 1/2 a large onion and sautéed them instead of using the green onions, mushrooms, and canned peppers. I also used 8 oz. of shredded sharp cheddar instead of the 16 oz.

This is our go-to Christmas breakfast. I've been making it for years. It's so good that my kiddos commonly request this for their birthday brunch, too. When I make it I use a whole pound of sausage, and a dozen eggs. All the other ingredients for the egg mix I keep the same. It comes out perfect every single time. I do omit the last step that uses the flour, too.

Super duper good! I wanted to make this a low carb option, so I omitted the flour, butter and baking powder mixture. I didn’t let this sit overnight either. I just baked it immediately for about 50 minutes. Came out delicious all the same. I cut it into squares for a work breakfast meeting and everyone loved them. I also used turkey sausage as I don’t like beef or pork. Will make again!

It’s good, but even making a few adjustments to add some oomph it’s a bit bland. I added some red pepper, tomato, oregano and garlic and doubled the green onion. I did reduce the cheese slightly and used extra sharp cheddar (what I had). Spicier sausage or another can of chiles might help (and/or more veggies). I needed to make it gluten free so skipped the flour mixture; I thought the texture was fine without but will be interested to see what it’s like with. I’ll make it again but definitely need to play with the ingredients.

I make this gluten free by leaving out the flour, soda and salt. I also add whatever vegetables I have - we especially like spinach. I have shared this with many people. So easy!
guests gave it 4 stars
Great recipe. Easy and flavorful. Used 1 pound of sausage so I had no waste. Otherwise made it Exactly like recipe said. Family loved it.

Crowd pleaser every time. Reheats well (if not totally consumed Day 1).My tweaks: I use italian sausage - purchased ground - and 8 oz each of Monterrey Jack and cheddar cheeses. Soooo much better than prior recipes with croutons or cubed bread!
Been making this for a Christmas morning egg casserole for years now. Always a hit. Sometimes I omit the flour for a GF option for others. But I prefer the flour texture.
I followed this recipe as written, no changes. It is delicious! The green chiles add a great flavor! Thanks for sharing this recipe.
I always use spicey hot pork sausage and 12 eggs instead of 10. I've made this for holidays, or whenever, for years. Always gets all the rave !!!
Was looking for a low carb recipe, so made this without the flour mixture… delicious! My mom is making this now too!
It’s easy to make and is soooo yummy! I never have leftovers!
